validity_ledger.zero_semantics: T1 drift and signed test change are exact anchor-reference zeros; zero sample SD can be observed for discrete accuracy.
validity_ledger.structural_nulls: S_path at T1 is undefined because drift=0; no T1 path record and no zero imputation.
validity_ledger.checkpoint_verification: Recorded checkpoint SHA matches raw states/manifests/endpoint recovery/training completion receipts; files exist. Large checkpoint payloads not reread or executed.

definitions.accuracy: 307 Task0 test examples; fixed original 20-class head; percent, differences in percentage points
definitions.accuracy_drop_from_anchor_pp: Own Task0 anchor accuracy minus current accuracy; positive means accuracy lost, negative means improvement
definitions.signed_test_damage: CE_test(W_t)-CE_test(W_0), each method and seed uses its own anchor; signed, no clipping
definitions.weight_drift: Euclidean norm of concatenated effective Q/V BA matrix displacement from own Task0 anchor
definitions.S_path: Simpson integral_0^1 Delta_t^T F_emp_train(W_0+s Delta_t) Delta_t ds / ||Delta_t||_2^2
definitions.fisher: 1259 Task0 training examples; true-label per-example gradients; 24 effective Q/V matrices; no lambda multiplication, floor, regularization or trace normalization
definitions.normalization: Normalize each seed integral by its own drift squared, then average the three ratios
definitions.sample_sd: ddof=1 across 3 independent training seeds; no shading in current figure but SD retained in CSV
definitions.pairing: gam minus sgd at same seed and same T; 27 future-stage pairs are dependent repeated stages from three training seeds
definitions.paths: Separate Task0-to-endpoint straight chords; nodes are interpolation locations, not tasks or actual optimizer updates

source_audit.checkpoint_verification: recorded SHA across original trajectory, path manifest, raw states and endpoint recovery; original runner rehashes payloads at job start
source_audit.metric: S_path = Simpson integral of Delta^T F_emp Delta / ||Delta||^2
source_audit.path_scope: 1259 old-task training examples; true-label per-example effective Q/V Fisher; fixed 20-class old-task head

interpretation.supported: Consistent same-stage association of better Task0 test retention, larger endpoint displacement and lower measured normalized directional path Fisher.
interpretation.causal_limit: GAM remains enabled at Task1-9. B2 compares two complete training procedures and cannot isolate a Task0-only shaping causal effect.
interpretation.metric_limit: Directional empirical-Fisher chord average is neither a Hessian eigenvalue nor endpoint Fisher trace; smaller S_path alone does not establish a global flatness or test-loss bound.
interpretation.uncertainty: Only three independent training seeds. No claim of statistical significance from 27 dependent stage-seed pairs.
interpretation.nonmonotonic: Accuracy, signed loss change and S_path are not strictly monotone; counterexamples and adjacent-stage changes are retained.
interpretation.next_experiment: To isolate anchor shaping, fix later-task optimizer/training protocol across paired SGD/GAM anchors and preserve full-state/Fisher matching; this analysis launches no new runs.
